tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: Every public dataset on this server: what it covers, its version, DOI, license (CC BY 4.0), credit line, last-checked date, the page to cite, its files and its tools.

tools.name: cite
tools.description: The citation sentence, credit line, DOI and URL to cite: for a whole dataset, for one state, or for one rule cell (dataset "rules" with state and topic), or for one record id in another dataset. CC BY 4.0 asks for credit and a link.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Confirmed changes across the datasets, newest first, each with its date, what changed and its source. Optional `since` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `datasets` filter.

tools.name: get_state_rules
tools.description: Every lawyer advertising rule we track for one US state or DC (ad filing, required content, waiting periods, claims and testimonials, referral and lead rules, other languages, call recording, texting law, privacy law), each with its plain-English text, status (P primary source, S secondary, D ABA mo

tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: One state's rule on one topic: the plain-English text, status (P/S/D/U), note, sources with dates, the cell URL and a one-sentence citation. Not legal advice.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: One rule topic side by side across several states (or all 50 states and DC when `states` is left out), each with its status, sources and cell URL. Not legal advice.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Keyword search over every rule cell. States (names, or capitalized codes like TX) and topics (filing, disclaimer, waiting period, testimonials, referral, Spanish, recording, texting, privacy) named in the query narrow the results. Deterministic keyword matching, no AI. Returns the best-matching cell

tools.name: list_rule_changes
tools.description: Confirmed changes to the lawyer advertising rules dataset, newest first, each with its date, state, the cells it touched and its primary source. Optional `since` (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: data_lookup
tools.description: The records for one key in one dataset, with sources, status and dates. tools.name: data_compare
tools.description: The records for up to 10 keys of one dataset side by side. tools.name: data_search
tools.description: Keyword search (deterministic, no model) across ca-courts, fees, filing, language, mdl, opinions, platforms, or only the datasets named. Returns the best-matching records with their dataset, sources and status. For lawyer advertising rules use search_rules. Not legal advice.
